senses.gloss:
Kodaṇḍakāvya
by Bhoja on a stone-slab a. Māṇḍu near Dhār.
See ABORI. XI. p. 49.

Kodaṇḍacaturbhuja
military science. work mentioned by Godāvara Miśra in verse 2, Dhanurvedapariccheda of Harihara Caturaṅga. (C. 16th Cent. A. D.) p. 14, Madras Govt. Ori. Mss. Library Ser. 17.

Kodaṇḍamaṅgala
a name of Kṛṣṇalīlāśuka or Vilvamaṅgala or Villumaṅgala; Skt. form of the last mentioned word.
See NCC. IV. p. 355a.

Kodaṇḍamaṇḍana
military science. AS. p. 51 (2 mss.). BBRAS. 428 (22 chs.).
Pt.. with Hindi transl. Moradabad, 1901. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 312.
--from Brahmapurāṇa. Burnell 189a. TD. 18820.

Kodaṇḍaya
of Bhāradvājagotra; father of Subbayāmātya an. grandfather of Veṅkaṭayogin of Gannepūḍi village (a. of Brahmavinnidhi. adv., MT. 4362).

Kodaṇḍarāma
of Bhāradvājagotra; father of Mādhava (a. of Rasanighaṇṭu, Trav. Uni. 1501B).

Kodaṇḍarāma
of Koṭikulapūḍi; son of Veṅkaṭakṛṣṇayajvan an. grandson of Veṅkaṭarāmaśāstrin of Hārītagotra; an. priest of Raṅgarāya, Rājā of Bobbili.
--Āryabhaṭatantragaṇita. MT. 371 (o).
--Āryabhaṭavāṇī. MT. 2156 (a..
--Daivajñakalpalatā an. its Telugu C. MT. 5262 (a..

Kodaṇḍarāmaśataka
Pt.. in Telugu script. Madras, 1842. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1358.

Kodaṇḍaśāstra
on archery. attributed to Dilīpa. Nepal II. p. 104. Rep. Hpr. 1906-11, p. 5.
